name: doom
summary: DOOM (doomgeneric port) — id Software's 1993 shooter + the shareware episode 1 WAD

doom.content:
#!/bin/sh
# NOT the quake cd-launcher: doom's configdir is "." (m_config.c
# GetDefaultConfigDir), so it MKDIRs ./.savegame and writes default.cfg
# into its CWD — cd'ing to the package dir would litter /opt/doom with
# unrecorded user data (breaking gucman remove's exact replay) and go
# EROFS under the baked /usr/opt/doom. So keep the caller's CWD (saves
# land in $HOME exactly like the formerly-baked doom) and hand the WAD
# over explicitly: -iwad takes an absolute path (d_iwad.c D_FindIWAD),
# and ours sits AFTER "$@" so a user's own -iwad wins (M_CheckParm
# returns the first match). Self-location is the known-prefix probe
# (todos/0444): /opt/doom installed, /usr/opt/doom baked (fat image);
# [ is a hush builtin — zero extra spawns. Variable-free by design
# (#296): builtins and literal paths only. The launcher stays the game's
# waiting parent (no exec) — job control and the e2e's pkill contract
# rely on that.
if [ -x /opt/doom/doom-bin ]; then
/opt/doom/doom-bin "$@" -iwad /opt/doom/doom1.wad
else
/usr/opt/doom/doom-bin "$@" -iwad /usr/opt/doom/doom1.wad
fi
